title: WorkerSettings
description: config/worker.yaml: how a worker process leases, polls, retries and connects (blueprint sections 6.2 and 13.1, ADR-0031). The rules between the intervals, and the floors outside the Test environment, are checked by validate-config and at startup.

lease_ms.description: How long a claim or a renewal leases the job. At most a third of it may pass between heartbeats.

heartbeat_ms.description: How often the worker renews the lease of the job it runs.

poll_interval_ms.description: How often an idle worker tries a claim and scans parked jobs. Shorter than the heartbeat.

poll_jitter_ms.description: Each poll waits up to this much more or less, so workers do not poll in step.

max_attempts.description: Failed attempts after which a job fails with attempts_exhausted.

retry_backoff_min_ms.description: The delay before a job's first retry; it doubles with each failed attempt.

retry_backoff_max_ms.description: The longest delay before a retry. At least retry_backoff_min_ms.

tool_servers.description: The MCP servers the worker connects to. Their governance overlays are in config/tools/.

WorkerDatabase.description: The connection pool. The URL comes from DATABASE_URL, never from here.

acquire_timeout_ms.description: How long an operation waits for a free connection.

operation_timeout_ms.description: The limit on each store operation; the server cancels a statement that runs longer.

server_id.description: The server's id, as its overlay in config/tools/ names it.

url.description: The server's streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint, inside the sandbox network.

connect_timeout_ms.description: Bounds connecting and listing the server's tools.

call_timeout_ms.description: Bounds any single call; each tool's own timeout also applies.
